abstract: Treatment of choriocarcinoma is mostly successful but there is still appreciable mortality from early respiratory failure. A series of 135 patients with choriocarcinoma presenting with dyspnea between 1960 and 1988 was studied to find prognostic factors for early respiratory death and to identify how mortality may be further reduced. Mortality with respect to early respiratory death (ERD) was 11% and was significantly associated with WHO prognostic score, chest X-ray appearance, central cyanosis, tachycardia, anemia, and clinical evidence of pulmonary hypertension. Indicators on chest X ray of high risk of ERD were the presence of more than 10 opacities, extensive opacification of lung fields, size of metastases, and hazy background obscuring the vascular pattern. Intensity of initial treatment was not correlated with this outcome. A set of criteria has been derived which will predict ERD with 100% sensitivity and 38% positive predictive value. These are opacification of lung fields on chest X ray of more than 50%, OR initial plasma hCG level greater than 10(5) when there is anemia and a history of chest pain. Patients presenting with choriocarcinoma and dyspnea who fulfill these criteria should be considered for extracorporeal perfusion techniques. As respiratory failure in this condition is characterized by hypoxemia and right-to-left shunting, extracorporeal perfusion should be effective. Ventilation should be avoided as no patient survived mechanical ventilation.
abstract_ja: 1960年から1988年の間に呼吸困難を呈した絨毛癌患者135例を検討し、早期呼吸死(ERD)に関する予後因子を明らかにするとともに、死亡率をさらに減らす方法を検討した。早期呼吸死による死亡率は11%であり、WHO予後スコア、胸部X線像、中心性チアノーゼ、頻脈、貧血、肺高血圧症の臨床所見と有意に関連していた。胸部X線で早期呼吸死の高リスクを示す指標は、10個を超える陰影の存在、肺野の広範な陰影化、転移巣の大きさ、血管陰影を不明瞭にする霞んだ背景であった。初期治療の強度はこの転帰と相関しなかった。早期呼吸死を感度100%で予測する基準が導かれ、陽性的中率は38%であった。すなわち、胸部X線で肺野の陰影化が50%を超える場合、または貧血があり胸痛の既往があって初回ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が10⁵を超える場合である。絨毛癌で呼吸困難を呈し、これらの基準を満たす患者は、体外灌流法を考慮すべきである。この疾患の呼吸不全は低酸素血症と右左シャントを特徴とするため、体外灌流は有効と思われる。人工換気は避けるべきであり、機械換気を受けた患者は一人も生存しなかった。
